entry.title: Mes Bridge

groundCutout.basis: Native original bent bridge and reconstructed rock-bank contact apron; clear coarse terrain through the thirteen openings. Independent river-water layer remains visible.

terrainReference.basis: Mapped western historic-body approach; host ground sample minus reconstructed deck modelHeight8.05 defines the native base. ASIG relative controls inform outer ramps and rock shoulders; vertical datum is not assumed.

entry.note: Exact mappedQ856285 centerline and signed+X ENE/+Z SSE retained. The host samples the western historic-body bank reference19.57450452530542,42.11438275561773 at modelHeight8.05; it does not use the mid-channel anchor height. Public ASIG2015-2017 adaptive terrain provides relative outer-approach controls and bank shoulder contacts; rock/support tops remain photo-scaled reconstruction. Explicit ground opening prevents coarse terrain from filling the arches; host Kir water stays independent. No absolute vertical datum is assumed. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
